pli-tv-bi-vb-pj7:1.1: tena samayena buddho bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pj7:1.2: tena kho pana samayena thullanandā bhikkhunī samaggena saṅghena ukkhittaṃ ariṭṭhaṃ bhikkhuṃ gaddhabādhipubbaṃ anuvattati.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pj7:1.3: yā tā bhikkhuniyo appicchā …pe… tā ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti
pli-tv-bi-vb-pj7:1.4: “kathaṃ hi nāma ayyā thullanandā samaggena saṅghena ukkhittaṃ ariṭṭhaṃ bhikkhuṃ gaddhabādhipubbaṃ anuvattissatī”ti. …pe…
pli-tv-bi-vb-pj7:1.5: saccaṃ kira bhikkhave thullanandā bhikkhunī samaggena saṅghena ukkhittaṃ ariṭṭhaṃ bhikkhuṃ gaddhabādhipubbaṃ anuvattatīti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pj7:1.8: kathaṃ hi nāma bhikkhave thullanandā bhikkhunī samaggena saṅghena ukkhittaṃ ariṭṭhaṃ bhikkhuṃ gaddhabādhipubbaṃ anuvattissati.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pj7:1.10: evañca pana bhikkhave bhikkhuniyo imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddisantu.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pj7:1.11.1: yā pana bhikkhunī samaggena saṅghena ukkhittaṃ bhikkhuṃ dhammena vinayena satthusāsanena anādaraṃ appatikāraṃ akatasahāyaṃ tamanuvatteyya. sā bhikkhunī bhikkhunīhi evamassa vacanīyā:
pli-tv-bi-vb-pj7:1.12: eso kho ayye, bhikkhu samaggena saṅghena ukkhitto dhammena vinayena satthusāsanena anādaro appatikāro akatasahāyo māyye etaṃ bhikkhuṃ anuvattīti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pj7:1.13: evañca sā bhikkhunī bhikkhunīhi vuccamānā tatheva paggaṇheyya. sā bhikkhunī bhikkhunīhi yāvatatiyaṃ samanubhāsitabbā tassa paṭinissaggāya.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pj7:1.14: yāvatatiyañce samanubhāsiyamānā taṃ paṭinissajjeyya, iccetaṃ kusalaṃ,
pli-tv-bi-vb-pj7:1.15: no ce paṭinissajjeyya, ayampi pārājikā hoti asaṃvāsā. ukkhittānuvattikāti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pj7:2.1.8: āpattiyā adassane vā appaṭikamme vā diṭṭhiyā appaṭinissagge vā ukkhitto.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pj7:2.1.14: saṅghaṃ vā gaṇaṃ vā puggalaṃ vā kammaṃ vā nādiyati.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pj7:2.1.19: so tehi saddhiṃ natthi tena vuccati akatasahāyoti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pj7:2.1.21: yaṃdiṭṭhiko so hoti yaṃkhantiko yaṃruciko sāpi taṃdiṭṭhikā hoti taṃ khantikā taṃ rucikā.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pj7:2.1.25: aññāhi bhikkhunīhi yā passanti yā suṇanti tāhi vattabbā.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pj7:2.1.26: eso kho ayye bhikkhu samaggena saṅghena ukkhitto dhammena vinayena satthusāsanena anādaro appatikāro akatasahāyo
pli-tv-bi-vb-pj7:2.1.34: eso kho ayye bhikkhu samaggena saṅghena ukkhitto dhammena vinayena satthusāsanena anādaro appatikāro akatasahāyo
pli-tv-bi-vb-pj7:2.1.44: ayaṃ itthannāmā bhikkhunī samaggena saṅghena ukkhittaṃ bhikkhuṃ dhammena vinayena satthusāsanena anādaraṃ appatikāraṃ akatasahāyaṃ tamanuvattati, sā taṃ vatthuṃ nappaṭinissajjati.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pj7:2.1.45: yadi saṅghassa pattakallaṃ, saṅgho itthannāmaṃ bhikkhuniṃ samanubhāseyya tassa vatthussa paṭinissaggāya
pli-tv-bi-vb-pj7:2.1.48: ayaṃ itthannāmā bhikkhunī samaggena saṅghena ukkhittaṃ bhikkhuṃ dhammena vinayena satthusāsanena anādaraṃ appatikāraṃ akatasahāyaṃ tamanuvattati.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pj7:2.1.50: saṅgho itthannāmaṃ bhikkhuniṃ samanubhāsati tassa vatthussa paṭinissaggāya,
pli-tv-bi-vb-pj7:2.1.51: yassā ayyāya khamati itthannāmāya bhikkhuniyā samanubhāsanā tassa vatthussa paṭinissaggāya. sā tuṇhassa
pli-tv-bi-vb-pj7:2.1.55: samanubhaṭṭhā saṅghena itthannāmā bhikkhunī tassa vatthussa paṭinissaggāya
pli-tv-bi-vb-pj7:2.1.56: khamati saṅghassa tasmā tuṇhī, evametaṃ dhārayāmīti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pj7:2.1.63: seyyathāpi nāma puthusilā dvedhā bhinnā appaṭisandhikā hoti evameva bhikkhunī yāvatatiyaṃ samanubhāsanāya nappaṭinissajjantī, assamaṇī hoti asakyadhītā tena vuccati pārājikā hotīti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pj7:2.1.65: saṃvāso nāma: ekakammaṃ ekuddeso samasikkhatā, eso saṃvāso nāma.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pj7:2.1.66: so tāya saddhiṃ natthi, tena vuccati asaṃvāsāti.
